offence_note: Trafficking in cocaine and possession for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I therefore sentence you Mr. Carver to serve a two-year sentence concurrent on both counts in a federal penitentiary.
note: 228 days strict house arrest put in the mix as mitigating.

offence_note: Firearms prohibition order; underlying offence not shown
sentence_quote: to allow this appeal, set aside the order of the Court of Appeal and restore the trial judge's order.
note: Crown appeal restores ten-year firearms prohibition; offence and jail term not shown.

offence_note: Break and enter of mobile home; possession of break-in tool
sentence_quote: For the offences and the offender the sentence was well within the appropriate range and entirely fit.
note: Concurrent nine months for possession of blowtorch; leave granted, appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking of several drugs; possession of proceeds
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the appeal from sentence except to the extent that I would set aside the victim surcharge of $1,600.
note: Mental health rejected as mitigating; victim surcharge set aside.

offence_note: Two first-degree murders and two attempted murders
sentence_quote: In respect of Count 1, the first-degree murder of Jagvir Malhi, I sentence you to life imprisonment with no eligibility for parole until the expiry of 25 years.
note: Life concurrent on all four counts; lifetime weapons prohibition.

offence_note: Break and enter into a dwelling
sentence_quote: The court is going to order and direct that you be imprisoned in a federal institution for a period of two years plus a day.
note: Joint submission; no prior break-and-enter findings treated as mitigating; $300 surcharge.

offence_note: Break and enter, threatening, possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: I would give credit for 32 days to attach to the six month sentence for the break and enter.
note: Eight months total (6+1+1 consecutive); appeal allowed only to give 32 days pre-sentence custody credit.

offence_note: Manslaughter of fellow inmate; dangerous offender designation
sentence_quote: I would also dismiss the appeal from the sentence of imprisonment for an indeterminate term imposed as a result of the dangerous offender finding.
note: Dual status offender also under Review Board detention at Oak Ridge (NCRMD), not part of sentence.

offence_note: Marijuana grow operation: production and possession for trafficking
co_offenders: N. McVannell: 10 months jail; S. McVannell: 14 months conditional sentence
sentence_quote: In my view, the circumstances here justify the sentence requested by the Crown, namely three years imprisonment.
note: Harrison committed offence while serving conditional sentence for same offence.

offence_note: Marihuana production, possession for trafficking, theft of electricity
sentence_quote: I conclude that a sentence of 12 months is appropriate and I impose that as the sentence in this case.
note: House forfeited; co-accused wife acquitted; lifetime s. 109 prohibition.

offence_note: Sexual assault, gross indecency, sexual exploitation of young girl
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted but the appeal is dismissed.
note: Corollary orders imposed at trial but not specified.

offence_note: Human trafficking of minors, sexual interference, child pornography, sexual assault
sentence_quote: accepting the joint recommendation of a total sentence of eight years. It will be less time served of 840 days, leaving a period of just under six years remaining.
note: Joint recommendation; mandatory minimums consecutive; lifetime s. 109 order.
